rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name and ZIP and looked up the relevant orders and product variants. It also selected valid replacements and the refunds reflected accurate price differences. However, it violated key policy requirements: (1) It performed order-changing writes (modifying the laptop and the watch) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation. (2) It claimed the NYC address was in the user's profile, which contradicts the tool output showing the profile address is in Houston; the NYC address only appeared on a past order, so the claim was unsupported. (3) It attempted to update the shipping address only after modifying the laptop item, resulting in a tool error and failure to complete the user’s address update request, which likely would have been possible while the order was still pending. Although the agent escalated to a human when blocked, the request was not completed in line with policy due to unconfirmed writes, an inaccurate statement about the address source, and failure to update the shipping address.
